content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Pharmaceutical maker of injectable and inhaled drugs; no overlap with cutting, measuring or safety products."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Packaged food company selling pantry foods and spices; different products from Acme's tools and safety goods."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Children's apparel brand; different products, though it also sources from contract makers and sells to retailers."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Household and personal care consumer brands; shares mass-retail channels but not Acme's tools or first aid products."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Footwear and apparel brands; different products and customers from Acme's tools and safety products."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Automotive replacement parts sold to aftermarket distributors; similar brand-owner model but different products."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Apparel, outerwear and footwear designer; different products, sold largely to department and specialty stores."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Packaged meat processor with its own plants; different products and end markets from Acme's tools and safety goods."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Televised and online shopping retailer selling apparel, jewelry and home goods directly to consumers; different business."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Paper packaging machines and consumables for e-commerce shipping; different products and customers from Acme."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Household disposables like foil and trash bags; shares mass-retail channels but makes different products in own plants."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Protein snacks and shakes brand; consumer food products unrelated to Acme's cutting, measuring or safety lines."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Premium fashion apparel brand selling through own stores and wholesale; different products and customers."}]}
